_comment: Published optimal or best-known tour lengths, recorded as CITED FACTS.
No instance data is stored here and none is stored anywhere in this
repository: a tour length is a number from a paper, which is a fact and
not a copyrightable dataset, whereas the coordinate table that produces
it is the dataset. See docs/FIXTURE-B-BENCHMARK.md.
Supply the instance file yourself and the runner will compare against the
value here. If an instance is not listed, pass --optimum.

solomon._comment: Distance of the best-known MULTI-VEHICLE, CAPACITY-FEASIBLE solution. Not comparable to a single uncapacitated tour; the runner refuses to print a ratio.

C101.source: Solomon 1987; best-known set maintained by SINTEF
